rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00006.text:
$$クロウ$$
「...So in the end, these two
　were the only ones left at the base, huh」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00008.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「No need to apologize, $$クラヴィア$$.
　Just meeting someone like you is something to be glad about」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00010.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Hold on, $$アドヴェント$$.
　You planning to pull information out of her?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00012.text:
$$クロウ$$
「She's one of $$サイデリアル$$'s people.
　I don't see her cooperating with us」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00013.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「As expected of the $$リアクター$$ of the $$揺れる天秤$$,
　$$クロウ・ブルースト$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00014.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「No matter who you're talking to, you say what needs saying...
　that strong will of yours... it's wonderful」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00015.text:
$$クロウ$$
「...You know about my $$スフィア$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00016.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Yes.
　I saw it in the research data」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00017.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Of course, I also know about the $$悲しみの乙女$$,
　$$セツコ・オハラ$$, and the $$傷だらけの獅子$$,
　$$ランド・トラビス$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00018.text:
$$ランド$$
「So it's really true
　they were studying $$スフィア$$ here」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00019.text:
$$セツコ$$
（So $$ギルター$$ wanting to capture me...
　it's for research purposes...）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00020.text:
$$クロウ$$
「So, this researcher who missed her chance to flee
　is saying she'll help us?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00021.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Um, well... I don't think I missed my chance to flee...
　I think I was just left behind...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00023.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I'm... just an afterthought, even on the research team...
　So even if I hadn't been on the escape shuttle...
　surely... no one... would have noticed...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00025.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Ah... but I! I think this is a chance!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00026.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「If I'd stayed with the team, they'd barely
　have shown me the research data anyway...!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00027.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「That's why I'm going to observe $$クロウ$$, $$セツコ$$,
　and $$ランド$$ up close, and advance the
　Reactor research on my own!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00028.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I've already decided!
　Even if you say you don't want me, I'm coming along!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00029.text:
$$ランド$$
「Hey... listen, miss...
　being this devoted to research is fine, but...」
notes: お姉ちゃん (casual address to a young woman) rendered as 'miss' to keep Rand's rough-but-not-hostile register.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00030.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Do you get it?
　You're Sidereal... the enemy of us Earthlings」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00031.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Oh, no need to worry about that.
　I don't feel any debt of loyalty to $$サイデリアル$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00033.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Yes.
　I'm... from the planet $$エスコール$$, actually...」
notes: Escole: provisional spelling (no official Latin form found; Japanese sources derive the name from Escorpio).

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00034.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「By this planet's calendar, I was abducted
　about a year ago and folded into the Sphere research team」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00036.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「As expected of the $$悲しみの乙女$$, $$セツコ$$...
　You'd sympathize with an afterthought like me」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00037.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「But it's all right.
　To think I'd get to meet the three Reactors
　$$サイデリアル$$ had marked, like this...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00038.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I'm... so happy, so happy I could faint!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00039.text:
$$ランド$$
「And here you were scared enough to faint at first...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00040.text:
$$セツコ$$
「But if she's willing to help, we might
　understand the Sphere even better than we do now」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00041.text:
$$クロウ$$
「...I'll pass.
　I know from experience nothing good comes
　of getting mixed up with a woman this obsessed with research」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00042.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Please don't say something so cold...
　If all of you abandoned me, I'd...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00043.text:
$$クロウ$$
「All right...!
　All right, so don't cry!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00044.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「If you'll keep me by your side, I'll help with anything!
　Cooking, laundry, even polishing the mechs!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00045.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「If you ask for it,
　I'll even kiss your boots!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00046.text:
$$ランド$$
（At this point it's gone past devotion,
　this is a sickness...）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00047.text:
$$クロウ$$
（I have to hand it to her for that single-mindedness...）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00048.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「There's no need for that, $$クラヴィア$$.
　All I ask is that you help me unravel
　the mystery of the $$スフィア$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00050.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Welcome, $$クラヴィア・アーゴ$$.
　From today, you're one of us」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00052.text:
$$ランド$$
「I don't see why not.
　Not if she's willing to help us figure out the Sphere」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00054.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$クロウ$$.
　If it bothers you, keep watch on her yourself」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00056.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Looking forward to it, $$クロウ$$.
　Let's show each other every last corner of ourselves」
notes: 隅から隅まで見せ合いましょう kept intentionally suggestive/ambiguous (mutual scrutiny vs. flirtation), matching Clavier's teasing tone toward Crowe.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00057.text:
$$クロウ$$
「No thanks...
　Just imagining it wears me out...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00058.text:
$$ランド$$
「Well, this one's settled itself out somehow.
　Guess the problem's over there...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00062.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Are you also a member of $$サイデリアル$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00064.text:
$$ランド$$
「Answer him.
　Your future depends on what you say」
notes: Referent of お前/him confirmed as the ??? character (later named Orion) via characters profile (gender: male, established, not inferred from name).

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00065.text:
$$セツコ$$
「$$ランド$$...!
　Talking to him like that will just scare him」
notes: him: same referent as 00064, confirmed by profile.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00066.text:
$$ランド$$
「O-oh...
　I wasn't trying to threaten him or anything...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00068.text:
$$セツコ$$
「Listen...
　Just tell me what you do know.
　What you were doing here」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00069.text:
???
「...I can't remember it well...
　It's like there's a fog over my mind...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00070.text:
$$クロウ$$
「$$クラヴィア$$.
　Do you know anything about this one?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00071.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I'm sorry...
　I'm just a lowly afterthought, so
　anything outside my own section...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00073.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I-I'm sorry, I'm sorry...
　Please don't throw me away...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00076.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「This base was apparently running experiments
　to create all sorts of soldiers」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00077.text:
$$ランド$$
「So the bug soldier we fought was one of them...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00078.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「So that means that kid, too, probably...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00081.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I understand what you're getting at.
　But I can't allow him to come along...」
notes: 彼 rendered as 'him', referent is ??? / Orion per characters profile (gender established independently of the still-unrevealed name).

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00083.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Must be from $$ブルー$$, out on recon」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00084.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「What is it, $$ブルー$$?
　Did you spot $$サイデリアル$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00085.text:
$$ブルー$$
「Yes.
　But they're showing strange movements」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00087.text:
$$ブルー$$
「The situation is unclear, but
　$$サイデリアル$$ forces are fighting each other」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00091.text:
$$ランド$$
「Old man Sal...!
　You're saying you were just some grunt for $$サイデリアル$$!?」
notes: サルのおっさん rendered as 'Old Monkey' (サル=monkey pun on サルディアス + おっさん=old man/geezer); consistent with later scene (STGZ3REN_00033:00106-00108, context_after) where Saldias objects specifically to the 'monkey' part and Rand switches to plain 'old man'.
Orchestrator: サルのおっさん unified as "old man Sal" across slices 11-12 (monkey pun not carried; Saldias objects to "Sal" at 00034:00017).

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00092.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Embarrassing as it is, $$サルディアス・アクス$$, 42 years old...
　A through-and-through private, yes sir」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00093.text:
$$クロウ$$
「But you were piloting an officer's machine, weren't you?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00094.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ah, you mean the $$シャウラス$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00095.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, since I was deserting,
　I figured I'd bring along the best machine I could」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00097.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Even if you yourself were only a rank-and-file soldier,
　the data recorded in that machine
　has its own value」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00098.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then you'll take me in!?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00099.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「If you're willing to fight $$サイデリアル$$,
　you're welcome here」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00100.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Absolutely!
　Those people worked us to the bone for peanuts...!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00101.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm from the second planet of the E3 system,
　and I never imagined I'd be dragged along
　on a deployment to a place like this」
notes: E3 star system (Ｅ３星系) translated as plain alphanumeric designation 'E3 system', not wrapped as a glossary term (not a proper name requiring research, akin to a serial/sector code).

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00102.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Seems like hard times are about the same
　whether it's Earth or $$サイデリアル$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00103.text:
$$ランド$$
「Don't go bonding over being broke together!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00104.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Anyway, starting today I'm one of you.
　Pleased to be working with you」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00105.text:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah! Nice to meet you, old man Sal!」
notes: "サルのおっさん" plays on サル (monkey) as a nickname pun on Saldias; rendered as "old man Sal" throughout, which preserves the abbreviation gag but not the monkey pun.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00106.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「About that...
　I have a perfectly good name my parents gave me: $$サルディアス$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00107.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Being called "old man" is just a fact, so I don't mind that,
　but I absolutely refuse any weird abbreviation of my name」
notes: "ヘンな略称" (weird abbreviation) ties to the サル/monkey pun; translated as refusing an abbreviated nickname, monkey pun not carried over.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00108.text:
$$ランド$$
「S-sorry about that!
　I'll just call you "old man" from now on!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00109.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「You... you're more sincere than you look」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00110.text:
$$ランド$$
「I know all too well how it feels
　to be called something you hate」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00111.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't go getting all worked up bonding over that!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00112.text:
$$ランド$$
「...So, where are $$セツコ$$ and $$オリオン$$?
　$$クラヴィア$$'s not around either」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00113.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Even though he sortied on his own,
　$$オリオン$$ seems to have been under heavy stress.
　$$セツコ$$'s looking after him」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00115.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I've asked her to compile everything she knows about the $$スフィア$$,
　while also looking into something else」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00033:00117.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right...
　The outcome will decide the course
　of our fight from here on」
